briefings.title: "Il faut un discours politique européen comme l’a eu Mario Draghi" (Jean-Pierre Petit)

people.name: Jean-Pierre Petit
people.role: Economist and President, Cahiers Verts de l'Économie

briefings.tldr: The global market rally is being driven almost exclusively by a high-performing U.S. tech sector and the AI revolution, creating a massive prosperity gap between a stagnant Europe and the rest of the world.
